description: mrremind is an R package from the PIK integrated-assessment modelling group for preprocessing data used by the REMIND energy-economy model. It organises model input series and prepares them for REMIND's scenario workflow. Users supply source energy, economic or land-use data and processing settings; outputs are harmonised input tables for the model version and years chosen. Geographic coverage follows the regional data supplied to REMIND. LGPL-3.0 source, package installation instructions and build information are public. The README points to a PIK package repository for the latest installation, so a user should verify version compatibility with a particular REMIND release. A limitation is that preprocessing cannot make inconsistent source assumptions physically or economically valid. mrremind can prepare energy-transition cases that affect electricity, fuel and transport infrastructure. The related catalogue OSeMOSYS model is a separate optimiser, not a consumer of mrremind tables. No source dataset or R package was downloaded.
